title: Unlimited Detail Real-Time Rendering Technology Preview 2011 [HD]
summary: Euclideon's 2011 technology preview of Unlimited Detail, a rendering approach claiming unlimited geometric detail in real time via point-cloud style data. The company promised more to come while keeping most work secret.
why: HN mostly mentions it as the infamous voxel demo that generated hype and then faded, with some viewing it as snake oil.
